queries.name: GetServiceRequestReferenceContext
queries.output: current canonical Customer relationship or unresolved; current Customer Contact relationship; source-owned Current Handler text/clear state; active handler Contact relationship plus alignment state aligned|stale|unresolved; immutable organization-at-use context and warning summary
queries.ordering: single bounded aggregate result; reference roles use closed enum order customer_contact,current_handler_reference
rules: Customer/Contact IDs come only from LLD-03 relationship rows referencing LLD-02 masters
Current Handler display comes only from sr_current_source_projection
handler Contact is shown as current resolution only when its supporting source observation equals current_handler_observation_id and that observation is not explicit_clear
stale handler relationship remains history/context but cannot substitute for current source assignment

queries.name: PreviewServiceRequestCustomerChange
queries.output: current/new Customer identities, exact SR/reference token, LLD-02 target lifecycle, existing Contact-affiliation warnings and LLD-06 classification impact
queries.ordering: bounded single change preview; warnings use closed validator order then stable code ASC
queries.rule: preview is read-only; commit revalidates under writer lock and participant failure fails closed

queries.name: PreviewServiceRequestContactReference
queries.output: current role relationship, candidate Contact identity/current affiliation, current SR Customer organization context, source-observation alignment, mismatch review requirement and exact reference token
queries.ordering: bounded single change preview; warnings use closed validator order then stable code ASC
rules: equal display name is never selection authority
Current Handler preview is impossible without exact current source observation

queries.name: ListServiceRequestReferenceHistory
queries.output: keyset-paginated relationship history including immutable referenced identity, organization-at-use context, origin, proposal/command provenance and close reason
rules: kind=contact uses idx_sr_contact_history with the selected reference_role or closed role order

pagination: History uses CURSOR_V1 deterministic keyset pagination with packet-bounded page_size; current reference context and previews are bounded point-state projections.
